title: FBI Photo B20
doc_notes: This document is an FBI report to AARO containing a still image of a UAP from a U.S. military system, noting that the timestamp in the image is incorrect.

incidents.summary: A grainy monochrome image from a U.S. military system shows one to two small, dark objects near a central crosshair reticle.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: The monochrome image displays a grainy texture with a central crosshair reticle.
